data.body: Host source-step proof (SSM command c5fa3fbf-7807-492b-ba58-6142c9760a71 on i-00880b2c7f13527c5, us-east-1): commands executed: test ! -d /opt/rebar/.git; git -C /var/lib/rebar/mirror rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree; git -C /var/lib/rebar/mirror fetch origin; git -C /var/lib/rebar/mirror show origin/main:infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template | sed -n '1,3p'. Result Status=Success ResponseCode=0. Stdout: true; first template lines beginning '# nginx site template for rebar.solutions.navateam.com.' Stderr only reported origin/tickets fetch advancement. Repo docs corroborate layout: infra/systemd/rebar-autodeploy.service says DEPLOY_REPO=/opt/rebar and MIRROR_DIR=/var/lib/rebar/mirror, with /opt/rebar the compose build context, NOT a git checkout.
